verdict.rationale: Luma's legacy ReadMe-hosted Dream Machine reference has a runnable "Try It!" request panel and per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions. The current Luma Agents API docs, however, are a static reference with code samples and no runner, and there is no sandbox, so runnable calls hit production on paid credits. Missing for 10: a runnable try-it in the current Agents API reference, a sandbox or free test environment for running examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The legacy ReadMe-hosted reference runs the "Try It!" request panel against https://api.lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/v1.
Luma's legacy Dream Machine API reference publishes per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions in the markdown mirror of every reference page
There is no staging or sandbox environment. Use a test key and small generations to experiment.
